de1.P3.C19.ly_do: Loi giai da cho du: 3 mat phang (SAD), (SCF), (SBE) deu chua SO vi AD, CF, BE la 3 duong cheo chinh cua luc giac deu, deu di qua tam O; short_correct dang trong nen dien 3.
